builds_on: HYBRID_ARCH_REFACTOR_PLAN.md + hybrid_arch_refactor_state.json (COMPLETE — MIMIC i2t R@10 8.23%->10.45% Target tier; Indiana 3.90% intrinsic; Stage-0 PPL 15.62). That plan is finished; historical reference only.
primary_thesis: Migrate the completed A100-40GB pipeline to H100 (94/141GB) and use the headroom on the three A100-era ceilings: (1) contrastive negatives capped at ~31 (in-batch only, no all_gather, moco=0) -> scale true per-step batch to 128-256; (2) Stage-0 undertrained (bs=8/40GB, 40K of ~117K steps) -> finish it; (3) 70M cap -> port v2 arch to 150M. Plus multi-source CXR data (IU-Xray excluded) for the intrinsic Indiana gap. Clean per-lever attribution held throughout.

floor.rule: no regression vs current best; recover Indiana floor

target.rule: MIMIC old-stretch parity + Indiana uplift + backbone PPL gate

resolved_decisions.slurm: training -> aisc-batch (7-day); eval/smoke -> aisc-shortrun (1-day); --gres=gpu:h100:X. 7-day cap => full Stage-0 in ONE block.
resolved_decisions.model_scale: 150M v2 — port v2 arch (HybridNorm hybrid topology, middle-mLSTM 25% ratio, attention pooling, mLSTM stabilization) into hybrid_150m_v2; fresh Stage-0.
resolved_decisions.priority: backbone + MIMIC — finish Stage-0, then scale contrastive batch to push MIMIC to stretch.
resolved_decisions.indiana_data: add diverse CXR (CheXpert/PadChest/VinDr); IU-Xray EXCLUDED from training (it IS the 743-pair Indiana eval set — zero-leakage).
resolved_decisions.per_source_text: free-text passthrough (MIMIC findings+impression; PadChest translated-EN) + label->prompt template (CheXpert/VinDr structured labels -> synthetic report sentences, CheXzero-style).
resolved_decisions.kd_teacher: BioMedLM 2.7B primary; larger frozen biomedical teacher (BioGPT-Large/Meditron-7B/OpenBioLLM-8B) fallback if PPL gate missed (141GB fits 7-8B).
resolved_decisions.python: target py>=3.10 on H100 (verify stack; fall back to 3.9 if a dep breaks). Keep 3.9-syntax hygiene (forward-compatible; preserves willi bridge).
resolved_decisions.multi_gpu_phase3: secondary — deferred until after single-H100 MIMIC win (Phase 6).

phase1_plan_of_record.goal: Create plan-of-record + resumable state + gitignore/CLAUDE.md wiring; validate; commit on h100_scaling branch.

phase2_h100_infra.goal: H100 trainer configs (single-GPU primary + 2-4 node DDP file), SLURM templates (aisc-batch/shortrun), py>=3.10 env verify, parity tests, H100 smoke.

phase3_distributed_negatives.goal: Grad-preserving all_gather in CLIP loss (gated world_size>1). Deferred until after Phase 6 single-H100 MIMIC win.

phase4_150m_v2_config.goal: hybrid_150m_v2.yaml (dim=768, 12 layers, [m,m,m,m,L,L,L,m,m,m,m,m], hybrid norm, attention pool). Param-count assert ~150M.

phase5_stage0_150m.goal: Stage-0 pretrain 150M v2 on H100 (~3B tokens Chinchilla, bs=32-48, WSD). Gate PPL <= 13.76. BioMedLM teacher primary + fallback.

phase6_contrastive_batch_scale.goal: Canonical recipe held; batch sweep {64,128,256}, accum=1, LR sqrt-scaled. Gate MIMIC i2t R@10 >= 12% (stretch).

phase7_data_diversification.goal: cxr_multi dataset (MIMIC+CheXpert+PadChest+VinDr, IU-Xray excluded) + CXRJointDataset text adapter. Gate Indiana i2t R@10 >= 4.04% floor (target 5.5%) with MIMIC held.

phase8_eval_writeup.goal: Full eval matrix + analysis/h100_scaling_results.md (70M-A100 vs 150M-H100 + per-lever ablation) + final state verdict.

open_questions.chexpert_vindr_template_wording: Finalize label->prompt template in Phase 7 (CheXzero-style start; iterate if in-domain MIMIC regresses).
open_questions.lr_150m_exact: 4e-4 vs 5e-4 — pick in Phase 4, confirm via Phase-5 loss curve.
open_questions.willi_retirement: If willi/A100 retired post-migration, drop py3.9 guards + validate_for_willi.sh.
